steps: Complete the pre-screening questionnaire on the official study page.
The study team confirms your RA diagnosis and eligibility.
Attend 3 clinic visits over 12-24 weeks at a participating California location for lab sample collection.
Receive compensation of up to $250 across the visits (amount varies per visit).
